# Fura

Fura is a Truck Transportation company. Fura is a digital freight broker that aims to deliver a zero-waste supply chain. They are backed by next-generation technology and a dedicated team of industry experts. They empower shippers and carriers to take control of their freight and deliver on their goals. Fura employs 77 people (+26.2% YoY, +16 people), founded in 2017. Headquartered in Frisco, Texas, United States. Its workforce is distributed across 11 countries (including United States, Serbia, Russia, United Arab Emirates, and Panama).

## About

Fura is a logistics service provider that implements a fundamentally new vision of how freight is moved – empowered with digital technology. We believe in creating seamless, flexible, and transparent supply chains as a result of combining technology, expertise, and a collaborative infrastructure.

Backed by next-generation technology and a dedicated team of industry experts, Fura is not just another logistics company. It’s a platform and service that empowers shippers and carriers of all sizes to take control of their freight and deliver on their goals.

# Fura Gems Inc.

Fura Gems Inc. is a Mining company. Fura Gems is a forward thinking mining and marketing company specializing in coloured stones. Fura Gems Inc. employs 387 people, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across 9 countries (including Mozambique, Colombia, India, United Arab Emirates, and Madagascar).

## About

FURA Gems is a pioneering colored gemstone company dedicated to the responsible extraction of rubies and sapphires in Mozambique and Australia. Operating across three continents, the company combines disciplined growth with a strong commitment to transparency, traceability, and operational excellence.

FURA’s mission is to deliver a consistent and fully traceable supply of responsibly mined gemstones, from rough to retail.
As a founding member of a blockchain-based traceability system, every gemstone is accompanied by a digital Proof of Provenance certificate.

In 2026, FURA achieved certification from the Responsible Jewellery Council (RJC), a major milestone that underscores its leadership in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) best practices.

FURA aligns its growth with the long-term development of local communities, creating positive impact that extends well beyond the life of each mine.
